pairs.en: Caves that stay cool in summer and warm in winter, carved by time at the heart of the oasis.
pairs.zh: 绿洲深处，岁月凿出的洞穴——盛夏藏凉，寒冬存暖，是酷暑行程中清凉舒适的一站。

pairs.en: Jabal Al-Qarah rises from the middle of the oasis like an ancient guardian, but its secret lies not in its height — rather in its hollows. Caves and passages thread through its rock, keeping a gentle coolness at the peak of summer and a quiet warmth when night falls — a natural wonder that drew the people of Al-Ahsa to shelter here since antiquity.
pairs.zh: 卡拉山（Jabal Al-Qarah）自哈萨绿洲中央拔地而起，如一位远古的守望者；真正的秘密不在高度，而在山体内部：洞穴与通道在岩层中蜿蜒穿行，盛夏时节自有一份清凉，入夜之后又留有余温——正是这份天然的妙处，让当地居民自古便在此栖身。

pairs.en: Walk its narrow corridors, where the stone almost brushes your shoulders, then suddenly opens onto a high chamber pierced by a thread of light.
pairs.zh: 当您走进狭窄的石廊，两侧岩壁几乎触及肩头；转过一道弯，眼前豁然开朗，一线天光自石厅高处漏下，光影动人。

pairs.en: From the summit the oasis unfolds like a sea of palms — a view that sums up why Al-Ahsa became the largest palm oasis on earth.
pairs.zh: 登临山顶，绿洲铺展至天际，椰枣林连绵如海——一眼望去，便明白哈萨为何成为世界上最大的椰枣绿洲。

pairs.en: Early morning or just before sunset, when the light softens and the heat eases.
pairs.zh: 清晨或傍晚日落前——光线转柔、暑气渐退的时刻，也最宜取景拍摄。

pairs.en: The historic Al-Fatih Mosque — one of the Al-Koot district's oldest, built in the Ottoman era in 962 AH / 1555 CE.
pairs.zh: 迪布斯清真寺本名法提赫清真寺，是库特区历史最悠久的清真寺之一，建于奥斯曼时期的伊斯兰历 962 年（公元 1555 年）。

pairs.en: In the Al-Koot district of old Hofuf, bordered on the east by Qasr Ibrahim and a short walk from Al-Jabri Mosque and Bayt Al-Bay'ah, stands Al-Dibs Mosque — officially Al-Fatih Mosque, built in 962 AH / 1555 CE by the Ottoman governor Muhammad Farrukh Pasha. Its popular name comes from the date stores and dibs (date molasses) trade that once filled the street beside it. Covering some 350 square metres, it follows the early Ottoman style, crowned by a large central dome ringed by smaller light-bearing domes, and long served as a teaching mosque where Quran, fiqh and hadith were taught in the Shafi'i tradition. Its eastern minaret was removed in 1391 AH / 1971 CE when Al-Koot street was opened, and after a partial collapse in 1406 AH / 1986 CE it was restored while preserving its old architectural character — a working mosque to this day.
pairs.zh: 迪布斯清真寺坐落在胡富夫老城的库特区，东邻易卜拉欣宫，离贾布里清真寺与效忠之家（拜特·拜阿）也只有几步路。它本名法提赫清真寺（Al-Fatih Mosque），由奥斯曼总督穆罕默德·法鲁赫帕夏建于伊历 962 年（公元 1555 年）。“迪布斯”这个俗名，则源于昔日紧挨着清真寺的椰枣市集与货仓——当年椰枣糖浆（dibs）多得流到了寺前的街上。寺占地约 350 平方米，属早期奥斯曼清真寺的样式：中央一座大穹顶，四周簇拥着开有采光孔的小穹顶。这里曾长期作为讲学之所，按沙斐仪学派的传统讲授《古兰经》、教法学与圣训。伊历 1391 年（公元 1971 年）开辟库特街时，东侧的宣礼塔被拆除；伊历 1406 年（公元 1986 年）寺体局部坍塌，其后按原貌修复，保住了原有的建筑风格。今天它仍是一座日常使用的清真寺，礼拜者往来其间。
阿比·伯克尔·穆拉家族里巴特

pairs.en: The Al-Mulla family ribat — a scholarly endowment founded in 1280 AH to house students of knowledge, still active today.
pairs.zh: 阿比·伯克尔·穆拉家族的里巴特，是一处供学子寄宿的宗教学舍，也是学术性质的瓦克夫（宗教捐产）：创立于伊斯兰历 1280 年（约公元 1863 年），专为求学的学子而设，至今仍在使用。

pairs.en: In the Ruwaidah quarter of Hofuf's Al-Koot district stands the Bubakr Ribat — properly the Ribat of the Al Abi Bakr Al-Mulla family — a scholarly endowment founded in 1280 AH (around 1863 CE) by Sheikh Abdullah bin Abi Bakr Al-Mulla. For generations it has offered free lodging, food and drink to students of the Islamic sciences arriving from within Al-Ahsa and far beyond, as well as to travellers, and it has graduated generations of scholars and judges. Built of gypsum, gravel, timber and palm trunks, it rises in two storeys of rooms around an open courtyard lined with arcades, with an eastern wing holding a well and kitchens. Comprehensively restored in 1430 AH (around 2009 CE) while keeping its old character, it remains active to this day under the care of the Al-Mulla family — a witness to the depth of learning in the oasis.
pairs.zh: 胡富夫库特区的鲁维达街区里，有一处当地人叫作“布巴克尔里巴特”的所在，正式名称是阿比·伯克尔·穆拉家族里巴特。里巴特（Ribat）是供学子寄宿的宗教学舍；“布巴克尔”则是“阿比·伯克尔”这一家族名在当地的叫法。这座里巴特属学术性质的瓦克夫（宗教捐产），由谢赫阿卜杜拉·本·阿比·伯克尔·穆拉（“谢赫”是宗教学者的尊称）创立于伊历 1280 年（约公元 1863 年）。长久以来，凡从哈萨各地乃至更远处前来研习伊斯兰学问的学子，以及途经此地的旅人，都能在这里免费食宿；从这里也走出了一代又一代的学者与法官。建筑以石膏、砾石、木材与椰枣树干筑成，两层房舍环抱一方露天庭院，院边廊道相通，东翼设有水井与厨房。伊历 1430 年（约公元 2009 年）经全面修缮，旧貌得以保留；如今仍由穆拉家族打理，照常使用，默默见证着这片绿洲深厚的治学传统。
鲁维达街区，库特区——胡富夫

pairs.en: The domed mosque inside Qasr Ibrahim, one of its most striking architectural features.
pairs.zh: 易卜拉欣宫内的圆顶清真寺是宫中最醒目的建筑之一。

pairs.en: Within the walls of Qasr Ibrahim in Hofuf's Al-Koot district stands the Qubba Mosque, the palace's most striking architectural element and one of the defining images of heritage Al-Ahsa. It was founded in 979 AH / 1571 CE, after some five years of construction, as part of a complex that included a school of Islamic sciences and a place for teaching the Quran. It is crowned by a central hemispherical dome about thirteen metres across, flanked by small corner domes, with a free-standing cylindrical minaret rising nineteen metres around a stone spiral staircase. Above its entrance, a gypsum plaque records the founding date in Thuluth script — a witness to an entire era of the oasis's history.
pairs.zh: 圆顶清真寺（Qubbah，意为“穹顶”）坐落在胡富夫库特区的易卜拉欣宫围墙之内，是宫中最醒目的建筑，也是哈萨传统风貌中最具代表性的一景。寺的营建历时约 5 年，于伊斯兰历 979 年（公元 1571 年）落成，是一组建筑群的一部分；同一建筑群里还有一所讲授伊斯兰宗教学问的学校和一处传授《古兰经》的场所。寺顶正中是一座直径约 13 米的半球形穹顶，四角各有一座小穹顶相伴；一旁是一座独立的圆柱形宣礼塔，高 19 米，塔内是石砌的螺旋楼梯。入口上方的石膏铭牌以苏鲁斯体书法记载着建寺年代，为绿洲历史上的那个时代留下了见证。

pairs.en: Inside Qasr Ibrahim, Al-Koot district — Hofuf
pairs.zh: 易卜拉欣宫内，库特区——胡富夫

pairs.en: One of Al-Tahimiyah village's old mud mosques — its history awaiting confirmation.
pairs.zh: 塔希米亚村留存至今的古老泥筑清真寺之一，建造年代与建造者待确认（信息更新中）。

pairs.en: In the village of Al-Tahimiyah, among Al-Ahsa's eastern villages near Al-Qarah Mountain, this mosque is one of the surviving old mud-built mosques of a village once famed as 'the village of forty mosques', of which only around eleven remain. Al-Tahimiyah's mosques are traditional structures of mud and palm trunks, and two of them — the East and West mosques — are listed in Al-Ahsa's official register of historic mosques. The details of this particular mosque's founding date and builder are awaiting confirmation from documented sources.
pairs.zh: 塔希米亚西清真寺位于哈萨东部的塔希米亚村（Al-Tahimiyah），离卡拉山不远，是村中留存至今的古老泥筑清真寺之一。塔希米亚村昔日以“四十座清真寺之村”闻名，如今仅存约 11 座。村中的清真寺都是泥土与椰枣树干筑成的传统建筑，其中本寺（西清真寺）与东清真寺已列入哈萨历史清真寺官方名录。至于这座清真寺的建造年代与建造者，目前待确认（信息更新中），有待可靠文献核实。

pairs.en: Al-Tahimiyah village — the eastern villages, Al-Ahsa
pairs.zh: 塔希米亚村——哈萨东部村落

pairs.en: An old mud-built mosque in Al-Tahimiyah, the village once famed for its forty mosques.
pairs.zh: 昔日以“四十座清真寺之村”闻名的塔希米亚村里，一座古老的泥筑清真寺。

pairs.en: In the village of Al-Tahimiyah, among Al-Ahsa's eastern villages some twelve kilometres from Hofuf, stands the Al-Tahimiyah East Mosque — also known as the First Tahimiyah Mosque, and in earlier times as Abu Al-Nu'ush Mosque, where funeral prayers were held before burial in the nearby cemetery. Its history goes back centuries; the village itself was once famed as 'the village of forty mosques', of which only around eleven remain. It is a modest mud structure of three arcades around an inner courtyard, enclosed by an outer wall and roofed with palm trunks, holding about fifty worshippers, built on the banks of the old Zuhairi stream with the slopes of Al-Qarah Mountain close by. In 2017 it was listed among Al-Ahsa's officially registered historic mosques, and its setting near Al-Qarah Mountain makes it an easy stop for visitors to the area.
pairs.zh: 塔希米亚东清真寺坐落在哈萨东部的塔希米亚村（Al-Tahimiyah），离胡富夫约 12 公里。它又名塔希米亚第一清真寺，早年间也称阿布·努乌什清真寺（“努乌什”意为灵柩），因为昔日逝者葬入邻近墓地之前，殡礼都在这里举行。寺的历史可上溯数百年；而这座曾以“四十座清真寺之村”闻名的村庄，如今只剩下约 11 座清真寺。这是一座朴素的泥筑建筑：三道拱廊围着内院，外有围墙，屋顶以椰枣树干铺成，可容纳约 50 名礼拜者。寺建在一条名为祖海里的河流岸边，部分墙体与卡拉山的山坡相邻。2017 年，它正式列入哈萨历史清真寺官方名录。这里离卡拉山很近，游览这一带时不妨顺道一访。

pairs.en: Al-Tahimiyah village — the eastern villages, Al-Ahsa
